hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -Eq '(cat|less|head|tail|echo).*\.env' && { echo 'BLOCKED: refusing to dump .env — print key NAMES only' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) add=$( { git diff --cached -U0 -- . ':(exclude).claude/settings*.json'; git diff -U0 -- . ':(exclude).claude/settings*.json'; } | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' ); hit=$(printf '%s\n' "$add" | grep -nE '(^|[^0-9.-])(4[0-9]\.[0-9]{4,}|-7[0-9]\.[0-9]{4,})|_API_KEY=[^ ]|gsk_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{10,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}'); [ -n "$hit" ] && { echo "BLOCKED: possible PII/secret in the diff being committed:" >&2; printf '%s\n' "$hit" | head -5 >&2; echo "(coords, *_API_KEY=, gsk_/AIza/sk- tokens). Confirm with the user before committing; tests/test_gps_vicinity.py holds known fixture coords." >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0

st=0; for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in *.py) python3 -c 'import ast,sys; ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1]).read(), sys.argv[1])' "$f" || { echo "SYNTAX ERROR in $f — fix before continuing" >&2; st=2; };; esac; done; exit $st
